subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3913
title: Requires the Department of Corrections to reimburse counties for incarcerating a defendant if the defendant is sentenced to a felony and receives credit for time served in a local correctional facility.
headline: HB 3913 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3913 was introduced in the House on March 6, 2025.
